seatedToss.guidance: میزین باشیندا اوتورون و نؤوبهیله یومشاق لوبیا کیسهجیغینی بؤیوک هدفه آتین. حساب کاغذدا، بیرلیکده آپارین.
steps: هدفی و حساب ورقهسینی چاپ ائدین و ایکینیزین آراسیندا میزین اوستونه دوز قویون.
راحات اوتورون، هر بیرینیز بیر طرفده. نؤوبهیله هر بیرینیز بیر یومشاق آتیش ائدین، یا ایستمیرسینیزسə کئچین.
آتیش حلقهیه دوشنده، آتان شخص اؤز ستونوندا او حلقهنین سطرینده بیر خانانی ایشارهلهیر.
Look at the ticks together when you stop, if you like. Nobody has to add anything up.
seatedToss.safetyLine: Use only a bag with a sewn-shut cover or a rolled-up sock, stay seated, never toss toward a face, and keep an adult nearby. Small parts are a choking hazard.
flags: 3 یاشدان آشاغی اوچون دئییل: کیچیک پارچالار
safety: Choose a bean bag with a sewn-shut cover, or roll up a clean sock. Check it first for holes or loose stitches, so no filling can come out.
Beans, rice and other small fillings are a choking hazard. Keep them away from young children and from anyone who puts things in their mouth.
Stay within arm's reach and supervise closely if anything might be put in the mouth.
اوتورون. میزدهکی هدفه یومشاق و آلچاق آتین، هئچ واخت اوزه طرف آتمایین.
seatedToss.previewLabel: The printed sheet: a target of three rings named Near, Middle and Far, from the outside in, and a tally with a column for each person and a row of empty boxes for each ring.
seatedToss.sheetHow: Lay the sheet flat between you. When a toss lands in a ring, tick a box in your column, on that ring's row.
seatedToss.print: هدفی و حساب ورقهسینی چاپ ائدین

seasonalPack.monthNote: هر آینین اؤز شکیللری وار. صفحه بو آیدا آچیلیر، و istədiyiniz باشقا آیی سئچə بیلرسینیز.
seasonalPack.restLine: بوگون تاپماجا یوخدور. دینجلیک گونü də یاخشی گوندور.

pairs.describe: Two rows of the same four pictures, in a different order.

seasonalPack.sheetHow: Print one page. Do one, two or all three puzzles, in any order.
seasonalPack.printFooter: Do one, two or all three. Stop whenever you like.

decorateACard.guidance: بیر مناسبت سئچین، سونرا بیرلیکده بویا قلمی یا قلمله کارتی بزهین. دوغرو کارت یوخدور.

steps.fold: Print the card and fold it in half along the dashed line, so the front is on the outside.
steps.front: بیر شخص اؤن طرفی، سؤزلرین اطرافینی بزهیر.
steps.inside: The other person decorates the back, or you take turns on one side.
steps.message: بیرلیکده بیر پیغام یازین. بیر شخص یازا بیلر، باشقا شخص سؤزلری دئیə بیلر.
steps.stop: Stop whenever you like. There is no right card, and a simple one is just as good.

decorateACard.materials: بویا قلمی، رنگلی قارانداش یا کئچهلی قلم ایشلدین. هئچ نه کسمک، یاپیشدیرماق لازیم دئییل.
decorateACard.previewLabel: A preview of the card folded in half. The front says {words}, with a simple frame of leaves and stars. The back has lines for a message and a line for From.
decorateACard.sheetHow: کارتی خط‌چین‌لی خطین بویونجا ایکی‌یه قاتلاین، اؤن طرفی بیرونا قالسین. پیامی آرخا طرفه یازین.
sheetRules: نؤوبه‌نؤوبه ائدین یا ایشی بؤلوشون: بیر نفر اؤن طرفی، او بیری آرخا طرفی بزه‌سین.
پیامی برابر یازین، یا بیر نفر او بیرینین دئدیینی یازسین.
هر کس هر واخت ایسته‌سه دایانا بیلر. دوغرو کارت یوخدور.

storyDice.guidance: شکیللره باخین و اونلاردان ایستفاده ائدیب، هر سیرا ایله بیر حیکایه دانیشین. دوغرو حیکایه یوخدور.
storyDice.passed: کئچمک عیبی یوخدور. نؤوبتی کسی باشلایا بیلر، یا سیز یئنیدن آتا بیلرسیز.

wordPicture.guidance: بیر شکیله توخونون، سونرا اونون آدینی بیلدیرن سؤزه توخونون. یا بیر سؤزه توخونون، سونرا اونون شکیلینه.

halvesMatch.pickLeft: ایندی اونا اویغون سول یاریما توخونون.

halvesMatch.apart: او ایکیسی بیر-بیرینه اویغون دگیل. باشقاسینی سیناین.

colorByNumber.fresh: ایشته رنگ ائتمک اوچون باشقا بیر شکیل.

picnicPlanner.summaryNone: Nothing is in the basket yet.
picnicPlanner.needTwo: اول ان آز ایکی شئی سئچین.
picnicPlanner.notice: This is a plan to talk about. Nothing is timed, rated or saved.
picnicPlanner.sheetHow: Tick each thing as you pack it. Use the blank lines for anything else you want to bring.

scrapbook.guidance: Turn the pages together, with the buttons or the Left and Right arrow keys. Add a few words under a photo if you like. Nothing you make is saved or sent.

scrapbook.intro: Choose two to twelve photos from this device. Each one becomes a page of a book you can turn together.
scrapbook.consent: Use your own family photos. Ask before using a photo of someone who cannot say yes.
scrapbook.privacy: Your photos stay on this device. They are not uploaded or saved.
scrapbook.needTwo: لوطفاً ان آز ایکی عکس سئچین.
scrapbook.cleared: The book is cleared. Choose photos to start again.

scrapbook.sheetHow: One photo to a page, with its words under it. Turn the pages in order and talk about each one.
scrapbook.sheetEmpty: Choose your photos on the game page to print your own book, or print this blank page and stick in a printed photo.
scrapbook.sheetWords: بو صحیفه اوچون بیر نئچه سؤز

collageBoard.unchosen: The cut-out is not chosen any more.

collageBoard.tookBackPass: The pass is taken back. Your turn, {person|lower}.

collageBoard.anotherSet: A new set of cut-outs is in the tray. The pieces on the board stay where they are.

gardenPlanner.chosen: {picture} is chosen. Now tap a bed.
gardenPlanner.needPicture: اول بیر شکیل سئچین، سونرا بیر یاتاغا توخونون.
gardenPlanner.replaced: {picture} takes the place of the picture in bed {n}.
gardenPlanner.cleared: Bed {n} is empty. Put it back if you want the picture again.
gardenPlanner.putBackDone: The pictures are back in their beds.
gardenPlanner.summaryNone: No picture is in a bed yet.
gardenPlanner.sheetHow: The beds show the pictures chosen on screen. Draw in the empty beds if you like.

coloringWall.guidance: Choose a picture and how many pages. Print the wall, and each person colors one or more pages. Nothing is timed, scored or saved.
coloringWall.previewLabel: The {picture|lower} split into {n} pages, {across} across and {down} down. Each page has a label in its corner.
coloringWall.previewCaption: The picture with the page lines and labels drawn on it.
coloringWall.labelsNote: Letters go down the wall and numbers go across it, so A1 is the top left page.
coloringWall.wallHeading: How to put the wall together
steps: Print all the pages. The first page is these steps and a map of the wall.
Each person takes one or more pages and colors them.
Colors and styles do not need to match. Every page is part of the same picture.
Lay the pages out by their labels, then join them with tape on the back.
Put the wall up where everyone can see it.
coloringWall.mapLabel: A map of the wall: {down} rows of {across} pages, labelled from A1 to {last}.
coloringWall.edgeNote: The dashed line marks the edge of each page. Lay the pages edge to edge along it, or overlap it a little.
coloringWall.pictureLine: Picture: {picture}. This wall is {n} pages: {across} across and {down} down.

findTogether.guidance: Take turns. On your turn, turn over two cards to look for a pair. Find the pairs together.
findTogether.first: {name}. Now turn over a second card.
findTogether.found: {name}: a pair, found together. Now it is the {next|lower}'s turn.
findTogether.allTogether: You found all the pairs together.
findTogether.different: {a} and {b} are different. Take your time, then press Turn them back.
findTogether.waiting: Press Turn them back when you are ready. Then the turn passes.
findTogether.turnedBack: Turned back. Now it is the {person|lower}'s turn.
findTogether.passed: Passing is fine. Now it is the {person|lower}'s turn.

drawingDuet.guidance: Take turns with one line each, then pass the pen. Anyone may pass. Nothing is sent anywhere. A picture leaves this page only if you save it.
drawingDuet.keys: Arrow keys move the pen dot on the drawing. Space puts the pen down or up.
drawingDuet.tookBack: The last line by the {person|lower} is taken back.
drawingDuet.noLine: There is no line by the {person|lower} to take back.
drawingDuet.restarted: The sheet is clear. The first person has the turn. Put it back if you did not mean to.
drawingDuet.restored: The lines are back as they were.
drawingDuet.saved: Your picture is ready. Use the download link to keep it on this device.
drawingDuet.paperRules: Two people, one sheet, two pens. Take turns: one line or shape each, then pass the pen. Anyone may pass. There is no right picture.

colorWash.guidance: Paint soft color across the page, one wash at a time. Lift the brush to stop, and stop whenever you like. Nothing is saved or sent.
colorWash.keys: Arrow keys move the brush ring on the page. Space puts the brush down or up.
colorWash.canvasLabel: A page of soft color washes

sortTogether.selected: {name}. Now tap the basket it goes in.

sortTogether.sorted: Everything is sorted. Look through the baskets together, or try another theme.
sortTogether.largerOn: Larger targets are on. Nothing has moved.
sortTogether.largerOff: Larger targets are off. Nothing has moved.
sortTogether.largerOnNewRound: Larger targets are on, with two baskets. Here are new pictures to sort.

picturePuzzle.guidance: Tap one piece, then tap another. They swap places.
picturePuzzle.pickedUp: Piece picked up. Now tap where it should go.
picturePuzzle.whole: The {name|lower} is whole again. Choose another picture whenever you like.

swapped.other: Swapped. {correct} of {total} pieces are in place.

picturePuzzle.guideText: This is how the picture looks when it is whole.
picturePuzzle.ownPrivacy: Your photo stays on this device. It is not uploaded or saved.
picturePuzzle.ownConsent: Use your own photos. Ask before using a photo of someone who cannot say yes.
picturePuzzle.ownNotUsable: That file could not be used. Choose a photo file, such as a JPEG or PNG.

finishTheSaying.otherEnding: "{word}" works too. The usual saying ends with "{end}".

wordSearch.guidance: Words go across or down. Tap the first letter of a word, then its last letter.
wordSearch.letterChosen: Letter {letter} chosen. Now tap the last letter of the word.
wordSearch.foundAll: {word} found. That is every word. Play again or take a break.
wordSearch.tryAgain: Take your time. Tap the first letter of a word, then its last letter.
wordSearch.gridLabel: Letter grid, {n} rows of {n} letters. Use the arrow keys to move between letters.
wordSearch.unavailable: A letter grid does not suit this language, so the word search is not offered here. Try the picture games instead.

coloring.guidance: Tap a color, then tap a part of the picture.

conversationCards.guidance: Read the card out loud. There are no right answers.
conversationCards.groupTitle: Passing a card round a group
conversationCards.groupSit: Sit in a circle where everyone can see the picture. The person holding the card, or the device with the big picture, reads the prompt out loud first.
conversationCards.groupPass: Then pass the card on to the next person. Each person says a word or a sentence about the picture, then passes it on.
conversationCards.groupNoSpeech: Handing the card on is always allowed. A person may pass without saying anything, and nobody has to say why.
conversationCards.groupEnd: دؤور، کارت دایره‌نین ایراغیندا بوتون اوتوردانلارا چاتاندا یا قروپون کیفایتی یئتنده بیتیر. هئچ کیم قازانمیر. قروپ هر واخت ایستیرسه، دایانا بیلر.

pictureBingo.guidance: Print the cards first. Then show this caller on the biggest screen you have.
pictureBingo.start: Tap "Next picture" to call the first picture.

calmBreathing.guidance: Breathe in as the circle grows, and out as it gets smaller. It stops by itself after six breaths.
calmBreathing.started: Started. Breathe in as the circle grows.
calmBreathing.finished: That was six slow breaths. Start again whenever you like.

storyChain.guidance: نؤوبه ایله دانیشین: هر بیری بیر جمله دئسین و سونراکی شکیلی علاوه ائدین.
storyChain.passNote: Say your sentence aloud. Nothing is typed or kept. Anyone may pass.
storyChain.fullAdd: The chain is full. Start a new chain
